verdict.rationale: Stripe documents official SDKs/OpenAPI spec generation, versioned APIs, a CLI, an official MCP server, and an AI/agent-focused GitHub org with agent skills and Vercel AI SDK integration, strongly supporting AI-native building against official SDKs. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration specifically of the AI SDKs/agent tooling (only vendor docs/GitHub cited), and the openapi.json probe returned 404s rather than a working spec endpoint.
